_comment: Weather shares per biome (area 3 item 1143). Weights for clear, rain, fog, wind, storm; WeatherCycle rolls once per region and 6-hour block.
_battle: Weather in battle (docs/ERA_FUNCTIONS.md, era function sky_battles, opens in Era III): the sky of an outdoor map lays this Rift field (BattleRules.FIELDS) for the whole battle when the map and the Wayfarer bring none. intro replaces the field's Rift line.

rain.intro: Rain lashes the field. Tide arts surge, Ember arts fizzle, and nothing catches fire.

fog.intro: Fog swallows the light. Umbra arts deepen, Lumen arts dim.

storm.intro: Thunder rolls overhead. Volt arts snap harder, Stone arts crumble.

_grades: Strength of a weather kind (WeatherCycle.strength, one more roll per region and 6-hour block, so it is the same for everyone). The first row whose upto is not below the strength names the grade; amount scales how much falls or drifts. Grades change the look and the name only: the kind (and so the battle field and the wild boost) stays.
_names: English names for Loc.t: grades, kinds and the looks of data/era_light.json.
_fx: How the weather is drawn (WeatherFx, called by EraLightLayer). fade_seconds: one weather glides into the next. density: share of the drops per 'Weather effects' level (off draws none). Counts are for a 144x256 screen and grow with the screen area up to max_area_scale. puddles: seconds to form in rain and to dry after it, share of path and grass cells that can hold one. rainbow_seconds: how long after rain a rainbow stands by day. thunder: the sound after a lightning flash. looks: rain, storm and snow layers are [count, length or size in px, x speed, y speed] from far to near; fog banks are [count, speed, alpha] from far to near; veil is the alpha of the flat cloud veil. eras: the colours of each era (rrggbbaa); Era I takes the four inks of the region instead and moves in steps.
